contract.application_relevance: Workers materialize binary responses into reusable file-like values.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Blob contains [0,255,128,65] and type application/octet-stream; Response is consumed but Blob reads are repeatable.
contract.distinctness: One-shot Body to reusable Blob conversion, independent of Y202 Blob-to-buffer result ownership.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(blob instanceof Blob, true, 'Response.blob returns a Blob value');
t.equal(blob.type, 'application/octet-stream', 'body MIME type becomes normalized Blob type');
t.equal(blob.size, 4, 'body-to-Blob conversion keeps exact byte length');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer())], [0, 255, 128, 65], 'binary response bytes do not pass through text decoding');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, true, 'Response.blob consumes the response body');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer())], [0, 255, 128, 65], 'resulting Blob remains independently readable');
contract.hypothesis: Body.blob may text-decode binary input, lose its MIME type, or fail to mark the one-shot Body consumed while returning an independently readable value.
contract.mechanism: Body.blob byte materialization and MIME-to-Blob conversion
preconditions: Reviewed exact direct-celld source/build/deployment pins and fresh isolated local store.
Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.

schedule.parallelism: two local body consumers joined with allSettled only in Y220; otherwise sequential

contract.source_observation: Pinned blob() uses arrayBuffer(), then Blob construction, without text decoding.
